title: Instant 100%
description: This mod add a command to give you all achievment, best tools, best tools,armors enderdragon egg and a bunch of other things.
body:
# 🏆 Win Mod
Win Minecraft with a single command!

This mod adds the /win command that gives you everything you need to become the most powerful player on the server.

## ✨ Features
The /win command grants you:

### 📖 All Advancements
Instantly unlocks every advancement in the game
### 🛡️ Full Netherite Armor (Auto-equipped)
Helmet — Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending
Chestplate — Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending, Thorns III
Leggings — Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending
Boots — Protection IV, Feather Falling IV, Depth Strider III, Soul Speed III, Unbreaking III, Mending
### ⚔️ Enchanted Weapons & Tools
Netherite Sword — Sharpness V, Looting III, Fire Aspect II, Sweeping Edge III, Unbreaking III, Mending
Bow — Power V, Flame, Infinity, Punch II, Unbreaking III, Mending
Netherite Axe — Efficiency V, Sharpness V, Unbreaking III, Mending
Netherite Pickaxe — Efficiency V, Fortune III, Unbreaking III, Mending
### 🎁 Bonus Items
64 Golden Apples
16 Enchanted Golden Apples
4 Totems of Undying
Elytra + 64 Firework Rockets
64 Netherite Ingots
64 Diamond Blocks
64 Emerald Blocks
4 Beacons
16 Shulker Boxes
### 🐉 Dragon Egg
Spawns directly at your feet!
## 🎮 Usage
Be an OP (level 2 minimum)
Type /win
Enjoy your victory!
